_comment: GENERATED by tools/era_scenarios.mjs from config/era_prices.json. Five synthetic scenarios, one per era of the mod's own tech ladder, each solved so its order book reproduces the fitted price path. Read by tools/extract_presets.ps1 and appended to ui/presets.js. Committed, because a scenario is a design input.

presets.label: Era 0 · 1780
presets.base_wage_note: era 0 lower-stratum SoL 7 via FINDINGS F26, base = exp((SoL−37.43)/10.49)
notes: Synthetic era-0 scenario, solved by tools/era_solver.mjs + tools/era_scenarios.mjs.
Prices are SOLVED, not chosen — untick "locked" in the price column to see the market reproduce them.
Population 5.5M with 80% peasants is the scenario's premise; every building count follows from it.
Army is 5% of a GROSS-output GDP proxy, in era-appropriate battalions only.
